human.name: Human
human.description: The most numerous and adaptable race. Lacking innate magic or superhuman strength, humans reach mastery through sheer persistence and craftsmanship.

half-elf.name: Half-Elf
half-elf.description: Offspring of humans and elves, combining human adaptability with acute senses and innate magical talent of their woodland ancestors.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: An ancient woodland people with long ears and an innate affinity for elemental nature. Blessed with longevity, keen eyesight, and archery mastery.

dark-elf.name: Dark Elf
dark-elf.description: Kin of elves dwelling in twilight groves and subterranean deeps. Distinguished by dark skin, superior night vision, and arcane magic mastery.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: A stocky, hardy subterranean folk. Unrivaled masters of mining, smithing, and ancient rune magic.

dark-dwarf.name: Dark Dwarf
dark-dwarf.description: Inhabitants of the deepest, perilous chasms. Master artisans tempering rare dark ores into deadly enchanted weaponry.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Diminutive demi-humans relying on sheer numbers, cunning, and cohesion. Dwelling in tribal packs, adept at setting ambushes and traps.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.description: Battle-hardened chieftains of goblin tribes. Vastly superior in stature, physical might, and disciplined battlefield tactics.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Muscular, ferocious demi-humans bound by clan honour. Valuing brute strength, warrior courage, and berserk battle fury above all else.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.description: Massive giant-kin of colossal physical might, crushing adversaries with colossal clubs and bare hands.

merrow.name: Merrow
merrow.description: An aquatic breed of ogres adapted to deep rivers and murky lakes. Deadly ambush predators of the watery depths.

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Formidable giants gifted with swift cellular regeneration. Fearing only scorching fire and corrosive acid.

scrag.name: Scrag
scrag.description: Aquatic trolls inhabiting lakebeds and murky marshes. Their healing regeneration accelerates drastically when submerged in water.

beastman.name: Beastman
beastman.description: Beastfolk who established formidable nations in the New World rivaling human kingdoms.

lizardman.name: Lizardman
lizardman.description: A proud reptilian folk inhabiting wetlands and lakeshores. Unmatched survivalists, scouts, and skilled hunters.

quagoa.name: Quagoa
quagoa.description: Subterranean mole-like humanoids consuming minerals and ores. Their hides and thick pelts absorb the hardness of the ingested metals.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.description: Mighty bull-headed humanoids renowned for unbridled melee fury, imposing physiques, and an innate sense of labyrinth navigation.

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.description: Steppe nomads bearing a horse body and human torso, uniting equestrian speed and grace with archer precision and martial endurance.

naga.name: Naga
naga.description: Cold-blooded serpentine beings endowed with keen intelligence, natural spellcasting aptitudes, and hypnotic charms.

armot.name: Armot
armot.description: Bipedal rat-like hunters possessing wiry, wire-hard fur and razor-sharp olfactory senses.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Bones of fallen warriors reanimated by necromantic sorcery. Void of fear, exhaustion, and pain; immune to cold and toxins.

skeleton-archer.name: Skeleton Archer
skeleton-archer.description: Reanimated skeletal marksmen firing shafts with mechanical consistency even across pitch-black depths.

skeleton-warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton-warrior.description: Risen warriors garbed in decayed armaments wielding rusted blades. Their bones are reinforced by dark incantations.

skeleton-mage.name: Skeleton Mage
skeleton-mage.description: Arcane bone casters retaining embers of mystic intellect, unleashing destructive offensive spells.

lich.name: Lich
lich.description: A potent sorcerer who severed mortal ties through forbidden rituals to attain eternity and supreme necromantic knowledge.

elder-lich.name: Elder Lich
elder-lich.description: Ancient and sagacious undead spellcaster whose arcane insight transcends the limitations of mortal mages.

night-lich.name: Night Lich
night-lich.description: A legendary creature of the night, plumbing the abyssal depths of forbidden arts to bend space and mortal minds.

overlord.name: Overlord
overlord.description: Sovereign of death and pinnacle of undead ascension, holding supreme dominion over the underworld with unfathomable arcane majesty.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.description: A reanimated corpse driven by instinctual ravenous hunger. Oblivious to pain and enduring shattering blows while intact.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.description: A swift, ravenous necrophage whose talons carry paralyzing cadaverous toxins.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.description: Aristocratic nightstalkers feeding on vital blood essence. Endowed with supernatural grace and hypnosis, yet vulnerable to sunlight and holy shrines.

true-vampire.name: True Vampire
true-vampire.description: A primordial blood sovereign fusing refined elegance with a monstrous war form and peerless regenerative flesh.

imp.name: Imp
imp.description: A mischievous minion of the lower planes sowing trickery, corruption, and minor pyromancies.

archdevil.name: Archdevil
archdevil.description: A supreme prince of hell whose gaze incinerates mortals, leading demonic hordes to absolute conquest.

succubus.name: Succubus
succubus.description: An alluring abyssal enchantress bending even steadfast champions to her bidding via seduction and psychic glamour.

angel.name: Angel
angel.description: Flawless winged heralds of the high heavens embodying sacred law, divine radiance, and purifying retribution.

angel-guardian.name: Angel Guardian
angel-guardian.description: A celestial sentinel warding righteous mortals behind consecrated aegis and smiting evil with blessed steel.

archangel-flame.name: Archangel of Flame
archangel-flame.description: A radiant champion of heavens whose burning blade immolates fiends and scourges unholy hordes.

principality-observation.name: Principality of Observation
principality-observation.description: An all-seeing angelic messenger detecting covert perils and shielding companions under a dome of holy sanctuary.

principality-peace.name: Principality of Peace
principality-peace.description: A tranquil celestial benefactor soothing worldly strife, curing mortal maladies, and restoring inner serenity.

dominion-authority.name: Dominion of Authority
dominion-authority.description: An exalted order of heavenly judgment appearing as hovering wings with testament tablets, dispensing divine decree.

cherubim-gatekeeper.name: Cherubim Gatekeeper
cherubim-gatekeeper.description: A colossal guardian of the pearly threshold bearing an impenetrable shield and holy lance of light.

seraph.name: Seraph
seraph.description: A six-winged lord of celestial fire, radiating primordial creation light and boundless sacred potency.

seraph-empyrean.name: Empyrean Seraph
seraph-empyrean.description: An empyrean sovereign of the highest spheres, dispersing any curse or blight before its transcendent holiness.

seraph-aerosphere.name: Aerosphere Seraph
seraph-aerosphere.description: A celestial warlord clad in luminous armor commanding tempest storms of sacred lightning and smiting from the firmament.

slime.name: Slime
slime.description: An amorphous fluid lifeform lacking vital organs, highly resistant to physical slashing and puncture impacts.

black-ooze.name: Black Ooze
black-ooze.description: A lethal darkened slime secreting concentrated caustic acid that dissolves metal, stone, and flesh in moments.

elder-black-ooze.name: Elder Black Ooze
elder-black-ooze.description: An ancient predatory protoplasm whose digestive enzymes liquefy reinforced shields, armor, and enchanted arms.

shoggoth.name: Shoggoth
shoggoth.description: A terrifying eldritch protoplasm with shifting eyes and gaping maws, flattening obstacles with relentless crushing bulk.

ubbo-sathla.name: Ubbo-Sathla
ubbo-sathla.description: A primordial amorphous demiurge spawning endless mutable life, possessing absolute dissolutive might.

insectoid.name: Insectoid
insectoid.description: Chitinous hunters boasting hyper-reflexes, compound multi-spectrum vision, and a resilient exoskeleton.

doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
doppelganger.description: Mysterious mimics flawlessly duplicating appearances, vocal timbres, memories, and mannerisms of their targets.

dragonoid.name: Dragonoid
dragonoid.description: Noble humanoids carrying draconic blood, blending draconic resilience with warrior discipline.

frost-dragon.name: Frost Dragon
frost-dragon.description: Lords of glacial summits exhaling freezing blizzards and encased in armor of perpetual ice.

fire-dragon.name: Fire Dragon
fire-dragon.description: Terrifying rulers of volcanic spires capable of reducing entire settlements to cinder with a single flame breath.

true-dragon-lord.name: True Dragon Lord
true-dragon-lord.description: Primordial sovereigns of the realm commanding wild magic, whose will alters the fundamental fabric of reality.

automaton.name: Automaton
automaton.description: Precision mechanical constructs free of fatigue, hunger, and sleep, devoted entirely to logic and design directives.

homunculus.name: Homunculus
homunculus.description: Artificially birthed creations distilled from alchemical retorts, utterly faithful and obedient to their creators.

sceleton.name: Skeleton
sceleton.description: Animated skeletal frame immune to poison, biological afflictions, and piercing blows.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.description: An incorporeal apparition haunting the material realm. Immune to mundane weapons and drifting freely through physical barriers.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.description: A sinister phantom of darkness woven from shadows and tomb cold, draining life warmth from any living soul.

spectre.name: Spectre
spectre.description: An exalted phantom radiating an aura of chilling otherworldly dread, subduing the will of those who meet its gaze.

blood-guard.name: Blood Guard
blood-guard.description: An elite warrior of the vampiric lineage, drinking strength and battle ferocity from spilt enemy blood.

vampire-bride.name: Vampire Bride
vampire-bride.description: A captivating, dangerous vampire of noble bloodline, weaving hypnotic allure with lightning-fast combat lethality.

vampire-lord.name: Vampire Lord
vampire-lord.description: Overlord of a bloodline clan, wielding centuries of wisdom, misty transmutation, and dominance over lesser undead.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: A shapechanger melding hunter cunning with lupine ferocity. Under a full moon, its strength and speed soar immensely.

alpha-werewolf.name: Alpha Werewolf
alpha-werewolf.description: A natural pack leader whose piercing howl bolsters allies and routes enemies in paralyzing terror.

true-werewolf.name: True Werewolf
true-werewolf.description: An ancient progenitor of lycanthropes, mending fatal wounds instantly and sundering forged steel with bare claws.

incubus.name: Incubus
incubus.description: A male demon feeding on mortal desires, dreams, and life energy, enslaving minds in euphoric reveries.

demon.name: Demon
demon.description: An infernal beast of the netherworld personifying chaotic destruction, cruelty, and brimstone.

devil.name: Devil
devil.description: A cunning archfiend adept in formulating binding infernal pacts and commanding legions of lower demons.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Majestic ancient wyrms ruling atop the predatory hierarchy, blessed with impenetrable scales, cunning intellect, and breath attacks.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.description: Enduring pack predators gifted with acute senses and flawless hunting synergy.

pack-leader.name: Pack Leader
pack-leader.description: A seasoned alpha predator whose furious rush and howl spearhead the pack into relentless onslaughts.

wolf-god.name: Wolf God
wolf-god.description: An immortal divine incarnation of wild nature, venerated as the progenitor of all wolf kind.

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: Swift and hardy equine companions providing trusty conveyance and battlefield footing for riders.

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description: Noble winged steeds gliding the winds, covering boundless reaches and striking from above.

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.description: Sacred horned equines symbolizing purity, gifted with curative arts and hex purging.

bicorn.name: Bicorn
bicorn.description: The fiendish antithesis of the unicorn with twin horns, tamed only by tainted and corrupt riders.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.description: A hellish steed bearing smoldering fiery hooves and burning gaze, leaving ash trails across the earth.

alicorn.name: Alicorn
alicorn.description: A legendary mythical equine uniting pegasus wings with a unicorn horn, mastering storm skies and creative magics.

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: A domestic fowl raised for eggs and meat, known for skittish temper and loud clucks.

cow.name: Cow
cow.description: A peaceful ruminant providing milk and leather, prized for gentle and docile temperament.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: An agile, independent domestic hunter of vermin with razor claws and acute night vision.

dog.name: Dog
dog.description: A steadfast companion and guardian, endowed with sharp scenting, loyalty, and vigilance.

goat.name: Goat
goat.description: A hardy, nimble mountain herbivore adept at scaling sheer rocky crags.

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: A flock-oriented herbivore with dense wool fleece, reared for fleece, milk, and sustenance.

fire-elemental.name: Fire Elemental
fire-elemental.description: A living manifest of fire searing the air around it and striking with lashing tongues of flame.

elder-fire-elemental.name: Elder Fire Elemental
elder-fire-elemental.description: A mighty pyric manifestation radiating incandescent white heat and summoning firestorms.

magma-elemental.name: Magma Elemental
magma-elemental.description: A primordial fusion of fire and earth composed of boiling lava encased in basalt crust.

fire-lord.name: Fire Lord
fire-lord.description: A supreme monarch of flame whose mere presence melts metal and reduces surroundings to ash.

water-elemental.name: Water Elemental
water-elemental.description: A fluid aquatic spirit morphing freely, quenching flames and slamming foes with hydraulic force.

elder-water-elemental.name: Elder Water Elemental
elder-water-elemental.description: A surging vortex of water shattering plate armor under pressurized currents and absorbing kinetic strikes.

ice-elemental.name: Ice Elemental
ice-elemental.description: A crystallized form of water elemental chilling space and skewering enemies with glacial shards.

tidal-lord.name: Tidal Lord
tidal-lord.description: An ancient sovereign of oceanic abysses calling forth tidal waves and ruling ocean currents.

earth-elemental.name: Earth Elemental
earth-elemental.description: A monolithic titan of soil and boulder possessing crushing weight and great physical density.

elder-earth-elemental.name: Elder Earth Elemental
elder-earth-elemental.description: An ancient earthen behemoth initiating tremors and gliding seamlessly through solid subterranean strata.

crystal-elemental.name: Crystal Elemental
crystal-elemental.description: A hyper-dense mineral entity made of durable gems that refract and disrupt magical beams.

earth-lord.name: Earth Lord
earth-lord.description: A primordial overlord of the lithosphere whose adamantine body weathers titanic and divine-scale blows.

air-elemental.name: Air Elemental
air-elemental.description: A rushing vortex of primal gale traveling at dizzying speed and carving air currents.

elder-air-elemental.name: Elder Air Elemental
elder-air-elemental.description: A destructive tempest tossing foes aloft and cutting them down with compressed vacuum blades.

storm-elemental.name: Storm Elemental
storm-elemental.description: A tempestuous stormcloud crackling with lethal electric discharges and deafening thunderclaps.

storm-lord.name: Storm Lord
storm-lord.description: A legendary master of skystorms unleashing catastrophic twisters and lightning squalls.

clay-golem.name: Clay Golem
clay-golem.description: A base construct of fired clay animated by a mana core, dampening blunt impacts with its viscous body.

stone-golem.name: Stone Golem
stone-golem.description: A massive sentinel sculpted from solid granite, immune to poisons and bleeding.

iron-golem.name: Iron Golem
iron-golem.description: A heavyweight automaton of wrought iron resisting mundane steel and packing devastating force.

crystal-golem.name: Crystal Golem
crystal-golem.description: A rare automaton forged of enchanted crystals reflecting hostile incantations back at casters.

adamantine-golem.name: Adamantine Golem
adamantine-golem.description: A supreme masterpiece of mystic engineering forged of adamantine, almost invulnerable to physical and magic blows.

raven.name: Raven
raven.description: A cunning, wary black-feathered bird serving as an occult scout and messenger in dark sorceries.

falcon.name: Falcon
falcon.description: A swift avian raptor with phenomenal eyesight plunging upon prey in blinding dives.

shark.name: Shark
shark.description: A dangerous marine predator with razor teeth and an unmatched sense for blood scent.

megalodon.name: Megalodon
megalodon.description: A prehistoric colossal apex predator of the depths capable of snapping galleons and sea leviathans in two.

octopus.name: Octopus
octopus.description: An intelligent cephalopod equipped with eight suckered tentacles, ink defensive shrouds, and natural camouflage.

giant-octopus.name: Giant Octopus
giant-octopus.description: A colossal deep-sea mollusk whose powerful tentacles crush vessel hulls and drag them into the abyss.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: A legendary abyssal monstrosity ruling the oceanic depths and whipping up devastating whirlpools.
